newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government bonds firm on interbank rate.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government bonds firm on interbank rate.

text.p: Singapore government bond prices closed firmer across the board on Thursday in moderate trade on retail and interbank interest, dealers said.
"Bond prices were marked up slightly today following another fall in the interbank rate. Treasury bill yields were slightly lower. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
Among bonds, April 1999 ended at S$98.65/98.70 compared with Wednesday's S$98.63/98.68, May 2002 at S$99.70/99.75 against S$99.64/99.69 and June 2003 at S$94.78/94.83 from S$94.68/94.73.
The overnight interbank offered rate fell to 1 0-7/8 percent versus Wednesday's 2-1/8 2 percent.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 2.40/2.30 percent against Wednesday's yield of 2.63/2.58 percent and one-year at a yield of 2.50/2.40 percent from 2.63/2.58 percent.
